title: cittānupassī
credit: Pāḷi text and English translation as in Mor’s Pāḷi Workshop booklet.

paras.en:
“And how, bhikkhus, does a bhikkhu dwell observing
mind as mind? Here, a bhikkhu understands
mind with craving as mind with craving,
and mind without craving as mind without craving.
He understands mind with aversion as mind with aversion, and mind without aversion as mind without aversion.
He understands mind with delusion as mind with delusion, and mind without delusion as mind without delusion…”
